metadata.name: GetLoyaltyTransactionsProcessingParameters
metadata.description: This API is used to get the details of loyalty calculation parameters.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: MonetaryTransactionCodeGroupID
request_fields.description: Unique ID for  Monetary transaction code group Valid Values: Fixed value provided by Corecard

request_fields.name: MonetaryTransactionCodeID
request_fields.description: Code associated to uniquely identify  the transaction. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 3742 =Purchase return reversal

request_fields.name: LoyaltyTransactionCodeGroupID
request_fields.description: Code of the Loyalty Group which is having mapping of all the Loyalty transactions. Valid Values:Fixed value provided by CoreCard. Example:4563

request_fields.name: LoyaltyTransactionCodeID
request_fields.description: Unique ID of the loyalty transaction code. Valid Values: Fixed value provided by Corecard Format:XXXX Example: 3801

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: Amount
children.description: The fixed number of points that are earned each time the corresponding transaction is posted against a loyalty participating amount. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00 Condition: This field is only valid if the Calculation Method field is set to Use Amount.

children.name: Percent
children.description: The percent of the loyalty transaction. Format: XXX Example: 100 Condition: This field is only valid if the Calculation Method field is set to Use Percent.

children.name: RoundingUnit
children.description: When Rounding Method is set a value other than None, this field is used to indicate the number of decimal places that is acknowledged for the points. Valid Values: 0-9 Format :XX.XX Example: 0.00

children.name: CalculationMethod
children.description: The method used to calculate the loyalty transaction. Valid Values:  0-9, A-Z Use Amount - Use the value in the Amount field Use Percent - Use the values in the Percent, Rounding Method and Rounding Unit fields. Use Tiers - Use the values in the Transaction Tiers group.

children.name: LoyaltyTransactionCodeDesc
children.description: Descriptive name of loyalty transaction  code. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: Loyalty Credit

children.name: LoyaltyTransactionCodeGroupDesc
children.description: Transaction Group for Loyalty . Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:Loyalty Group

children.name: MonetaryTransactionCodeDesc
children.description: Descriptive name of Monetary Transaction Code. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: 3742 =Purchase return reversal

children.name: MonetaryTransactionCodeGroupDesc
children.description: Monetary transaction code group for the loyalty transaction. There is a one-to-one match between loyalty transaction codes and monetary transaction codes; duplicates are not allowed. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z

children.name: PointsPerUnit
children.description: Indicates points per unit Valid Values: 0-9,a-z Format: XX Example: 2 Allowable Values: 6

children.name: RoundingMethod
children.description: Defines how fractional transaction amounts are rounded into the point amount. Valid Values: Round down to next rounding unit Round up or down to next rounding unit Round up to next rounding unit None Format: XXXX Example: Round down to next rounding unit Allowable Values: 50

children.name: MCCCategory
children.description: Name of the Merchant Category Code Valid Values:Refer 'Merchant Category Code Category' section for the valid values. Example: Airlines Allowable Values: 100

children.name: MCCStatus
children.description: Status of the Merchant Category Code Valid Values: 0-Inactive 1-Active Example: 0 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: CalculationMethod
children.description: The method used to calculate the loyalty transaction. Valid Values: None Use Amount - Use the value in the Amount field Use Percent - Use the values in the Percent, Rounding Method and Rounding Unit fields. Use Tiers - Use the values in the Transaction Tiers group. Allowable Values: 100

children.description: Defines how fractional transaction amounts are rounded into the point amount. Valid Values: Round down to next rounding unit Round up or down to next rounding unit Round up to next rounding unit None Format: XXXX Example: Round down to next rounding unit Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RoundingUnit

children.name: TransactionTiers
children.description: Defines point calculations based on tiered values. The first tier is the top end of the value range and each additional tier limit takes its beginning value from the ending value of the previous tier. The corresponding tier amount provides the loyalty points for that transaction amount. The initial tier begins at 0 and there are 10 tiers. Fields of this group are only valid if the Calculation Method field is set to Use Tiers.
